title: Signals on the chart
outro_say: That's the signals on the chart. | Next: planning an entry.

steps.screen: A card: see the readings where they happened
steps.say: The readings in your tables, drawn on the chart, on the candles where they happened.
We're on Bitcoin, with daily candles over the last year.
Sonar adds a strip under the price: momentum waves, money flow, and big dots where momentum turns at an extreme.
Sonar markers put the signals on the candles themselves. | Pick which ones to show in this row, and point at one to see what it means.
Chart shapes outlines head and shoulders, double tops and double bottoms, with the neckline and a rough target. | Gold and grey stars mark golden and death crosses.

steps.screen: A Signal Set as colour bands
steps.say: Show a Signal Set on the chart. | Every day is coloured by the Set's answer at that day's close: green where its conditions were met.
Dashed lines mark the big US releases: Fed decisions, inflation and jobs reports. | The next ones are drawn ahead of the last candle.

steps.screen: Turning it back to the basics
steps.say: Turn any of them off with the same pills. | Your choices stay with your account.
